description: The report organizes alternative ways to measure student growth in grades and subjects not covered by state assessments into two broad categories.
title: Two-category taxonomy of alternative student growth measures: alternative assessment-based value-added models and student learning objectives

description: The study defines group growth operationally as developing the capacity to solve increasingly complex problems, both the community problem a group attempts and problems of group operations.
title: Two-dimensional model of group growth (community problems and group problems, with growth, regression, and plateaus)

description: A methodology developed in the Canadian context, formalized by Albert and Murdena Marshall, in which Indigenous and Western knowledges co-exist in an educational setting.
title: Two-eyed seeing methodology

title: Two-faces framework: language acquisition as distinct mental representation and skill components

description: The authors describe two versions, or facets, of the large-scale epistemic game 'Mapping Meaning to Mathematics' in the context of solving separable first-order differential equations.
title: Two facets of the 'Making Meaning of Mathematics' epistemic game: Finding a Family of Functions and Fitting the Physical Situation

description: The brief presents two conceptual frameworks intended to guide programs serving low-income parents and children through combined activities.
title: Two conceptual frameworks for intentionally combined parent-and-child programs

title: Two-level measurement-based dynamic model of learning with α, β, and γ transition processes
